education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

There exists a number of varieties of lamps used in laryngoscopes. The variation fn sizes and in 
forms and sizes of screw threads of lamps made by different manufacturers has often imposed problems 
of interchangeability and proper fitting of the lamps in laryngoscopes. In order to ensure interchange- 
ability and proper fitting, the form and size of screw thread and essential dimensions of the lamp have 
been specified 1n this standard. 

This standard is a necessary adjunct tp IS : 41 1 3-1 967 ' Specification for laryngoscopes \ The 
lamp is illuminated by two 15V dry battery cells conforming to designation R14 of IS: 203-1966 
' Specification for dry batteries for flashlights ( second revision )
